submitted_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_customer_count FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM public.invoice WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2020-01-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2021-01-01' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) AS rc;
